source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: Gitit is a Haskell wiki: gitit.hs loads the configuration and starts Network.Gitit, whose handlers serve the pages stored in a git repository. ContentTransformer converts the markup via pandoc, with caching, .st templates and Haskell plugins.
